--- BEGIN TASK DESCRIPTION ---
## Problem or idea

Astral has durable profiles, private notes and linked memories, but the current public Plane facade has no first-class Wiki/Atlas page, revision and backlink contract. A project Atlas needs stable document identities and repeat-safe durable edits without storing product policy or adding another database. This child is limited to: add immutable atlas revisions and fenced page edits.

## Expected outcome

Append exact revisions and advance a page head atomically, with useful bounded history and conflict results.

## Environment (if relevant)

Astral system; owning repository: AstralPlane. Baseline: `a4eb372a9e9ae2aaf9f53b4f435721a4005d255c`. Python changes remain compatible with production Python 3.11. Use embedded PostgreSQL public facade/caller transactions only; every new durable contract ships with guarded repeat-safe populated-data migration and recovery evidence. Deep adopts only the exact qualified Plane revision.

## Acceptance checks (optional)

- [ ] Expose append/edit and bounded revision retrieval through typed public contracts; private content stays opaque.
- [ ] Reject stale concurrent edits, wrong owners and invalid replay; deleted pages cannot be resurrected through old revisions.
- [ ] Qualify representative existing-data upgrades, repeat-safe migration and recovery, plus real PostgreSQL atomicity and rollback tests.
- [ ] Include deterministic success, edge, denial, failure and recovery tests, at least 90% changed-code coverage, bounded required CI and necessary real-dispatch/staging/client verification in this same contribution.

## Supporting details (optional)

Tracking issue: [AstralPlane #52](https://github.com/AstralDeep/AstralPlane/issues/52). **Bounty: 200 recognition points**; this is a separately scoped contribution from the tracker's original 400-point allocation.

Dependencies: [AstralPlane #55](https://github.com/AstralDeep/AstralPlane/issues/55).

Existing linked work: [AstralPlane PR #54](https://github.com/AstralDeep/AstralPlane/pull/54); retain its relationship to the tracker and coordinate scope against these acceptance checks.

One PR earns one bounty award after a qualifying main merge closes its matching child issue. The parent is a non-bounty tracker; mentioning or closing it does not award points. Avoid a PR closing multiple eligible bounty issues.
